commitments.title: Memorial education and free student field trips
commitments.agency: Council funding to the 9/11 Memorial & Museum
commitments.description: Free field trips for New York City students, with a focus on eighth graders, and expanded educational programming.
commitments.locator: Council press release 3231, 2026-09-03, headline and first paragraph

announcement.title: Announcement located
announcement.note: The Council's September 3, 2026 release announces $1 million for the 9/11 Memorial & Museum for free student field trips and educational programming.
announcement.label: Council announcement

adopted_line.title: Adopted lines located in the Council’s Schedule C
adopted_line.note: The Council’s Fiscal 2027 Schedule C (June 30, 2026) lists two DYCD lines to the National September 11 Memorial and Museum. Page 281: $750,000 for museum field trips, stated as funding for 8th grade students to visit free of charge. Page 280: $250,000 for 9/11 Memorial Museum programming, covering in-person and virtual field trips. The two lines add to $1,000,000, the amount the Council announced; the sum is arithmetic and the lines stay separate. Smaller member and delegation items to the same organization in Schedule C ($50,000 p.134, $12,000 p.28, $10,000 p.110) are outside this commitment.
adopted_line.next: Confirm the DYCD contract registrations that carry the two lines.
